summary: Ephemeral prod trace mount + redaction pipeline smoke test & approval request
description:
Issue summary:
Request from Product Security to validate a new redaction transform on a sampled set of production inference traces. We need short-lived, read-only access to a timeboxed subset of raw traces (last 72h window, sampling 0.5%) to run the redaction pipeline and verify no high-risk PII escapes after transformation. This ticket captures the access plan, risk mitigations, and approval request to Privacy and Security for a 48-hour test window.

Why: We observed inconsistent redaction of free-text user inputs in synthetic QA runs. Before rolling the transformation to production, engineering needs to validate on real traffic to catch edge cases and tokenization artifacts.

Goal: Mount a sanitized, timeboxed S3 prefix copy (or serve via ephemeral read-only bucket) into an isolated staging workspace, run the redaction pipeline + differential output checks, and produce a short report with flagged samples and PR for fixes.

Deliverables:
- Timeboxed access window (start/end) and audit trail
- Redaction smoke-test runbook and results summary
- List of any non-redacted samples and action items
- Artifact deletion confirmation and log of access events
impact: Low user-facing impact anticipated. Risk is internal exposure of sensitive user text samples; must be mitigated with strict access controls, short TTLs, and audit logging.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Identify sample set: use production trace selector for last 72 hours, sample rate 0.5% stratified by model and route.
2) Create timeboxed copy into a dedicated ephemeral S3 prefix scoped to this ticket with server-side encryption and KMS key 'projects/redwood/keys/dev-redaction'.
3) Grant read-only IAM role 'redaction-smoke-test-INT-49821' to two engineers (Aisha Patel, Liam O'Connor) with console access disabled and session TTL max 8 hours.
4) Run redaction pipeline in isolated VPC workspace; save outputs to a separate ephemeral prefix with no public access.
5) Run differential checks comparing pre/post redaction outputs and collect any examples where heuristics failed.
6) Tear down copy and revoke role after 48 hours; produce audit log bundle and sign-off.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: current token-level regex rules miss concatenated PII tokens post-tokenization; synthetic datasets didn't cover edge-case concatenations.
Sampling approach proposed to balance privacy vs. coverage; sampling 0.5% expected to return ~2k traces across model variants for 72h window in us-east.
We will not include full KV cache snapshots or raw binary blobs; only JSON-level request/response traces containing 'input_text' and 'response_text' fields will be copied.
Security asks for proof of deletion and KMS audit events before final sign-off.
Requested reviewers: Privacy (Marta Ruiz), Product Security (Daniel Kim), SRE (Jordan Lee).
logs: Sample query used for selector: production_traces | where region == 'us-east' and timestamp > now() - 72h | sample 0.005
